orchestrator_status_v1.ev_export_handoff_source: Read-only provenance of the latest EV-to-export handover check: vehicle_feedback for the existing vehicle path, entity_report for an explicitly mapped local binary sensor, tesla_wall_connector for its qualified native local publication, or unavailable before the controller supplies a result. It does not identify a device or grant charging/export permission.
orchestrator_status_v1.ev_export_handoff_reason: Diagnostic reason from the latest EV-to-export handover evaluation. It distinguishes qualified local disconnection, normal vehicle baseline/off/disconnected evidence, pending recovery/stop duties, conflicting observations and unavailable or expired evidence. This is not a new session phase, ownership latch, command acknowledgement or proof of delivered export.
orchestrator_status_v1.ev_export_handoff_observed_at: Timezone-aware reception timestamp of the accepted local connection observation, or null when no local observation is accepted or the existing vehicle-feedback path is used. A native Wall Connector timestamp comes only from a new successful local payload publication; initial cache contents, repeated callbacks and unrelated entity updates cannot renew it. The timestamp is diagnostic, not a retained permission lease or a vehicle measurement timestamp.
